completion_criteria.text: Plugin installs into an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR sandbox (marketplace add + install succeed)
/mcp shows the ledger server connected (or GitHub #51573 spawn bug confirmed and worked around)
A hand-off records the thread to the plugin ledger (refs/heads/_ledger shows commits)
A fresh session's resume brief shows the recorded next_step (cross-session round-trip proven)

spine.active_goal: Prove the continuity-ledger-plugin works end-to-end when really installed: install -> record a hand-off -> resume from the ledger in a fresh session. Audit complete, sandbox staged, runbook delivered; Track B never executed.
spine.next_step: Await the user's SPECIFIC instructions; do NOT auto-run the runbook. Re-scope first: the LIVE global install on 2026-07-26 already demonstrated MCP connectivity and per-project store writes, so several criteria may now be provable without the sandbox.
open_risks: MCP server may silently fail to spawn due to `${user_config.*}` in the .mcp.json env block (GitHub #51573).
Plugin throws if CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA is unset (documented as injected; dir auto-creation unverified).
This thread's sandbox premise is partly overtaken by events - the plugin is now installed live and globally, which was the alternative that was originally rejected.
A second plugin identity `session-continuity-inline` has its own data root; two identities can mint separate stores for one project.
key_decisions: v1 archive: decisions/2026-07-20-sandbox-realworld-test-approach.md - isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR sandbox chosen over a live-config install
